about: The reviewed list of OpenStreetMap water bodies for the map around AD 1219, read by tools/map/build-water.mjs. OSM's own tags decide most cases: whatever OSM tags as a reservoir (water=reservoir, landuse=reservoir, reservoir_type, or Overture's subtype reservoir) is left out. This list catches what the tags get wrong: modern reservoirs and other man-made lakes tagged as lakes (dropped), and natural lakes tagged as reservoirs (kept). It also names the must-drop reservoirs even where the tags already drop them, so a change in OSM cannot bring them back unnoticed.
rule: 1219 rule: modern reservoirs and man-made lakes are left out (they were not there in 1219); natural lakes are kept, even where a dam regulates their level today. Facts about dams and mines (years, heights) are not stated without a source: 'details TO CHECK'. Where the choice is not sure, the entry says toCheck.
fields: name: OSM's name. osmIds: 'way/<id>' or 'relation/<id>' as in OSM ([] when OSM has no lake for it). wikidata: the Wikidata id OSM gives, or null. decision: 'drop' or 'keep'. why: the reason, from what OSM's own tags say where possible. toCheck: what is still to be checked.
